model_annotations.Bulgarian: The bar chart illustrates the accuracy percentages of various models across three categories: Mathverse, MMLU, and Physics. The horizontal axis lists these categories, while the vertical axis represents the accuracy percentage, ranging from 50 to 62 in increments of 2. The chart features six models, each represented by a distinct color and pattern: DAPO+Self-reflection (blue, diagonal lines), DAPO (light blue, diagonal lines), SRPO (orange, solid), GRPO (orange, diagonal lines), PPO+Self-reflection (green, solid), and PPO (green, diagonal lines). For each category, the six models are grouped together, with their respective accuracy percentages displayed. In the Mathverse category, the accuracy percentages range from approximately 53 to 56, with DAPO+Self-reflection and SRPO having values around 56 and 55.5, respectively. In the MMLU category, the accuracy percentages range from around 53.5 to 57, with DAPO+Self-reflection at approximately 56.5 and GRPO at around 57. The Physics category shows the highest accuracy percentages, ranging from approximately 54.5 to 61, with DAPO+Self-reflection at around 61 and SRPO at approximately 60.5. The bars are grouped by category, with no apparent sorting within the groups. Overall, the chart provides a clear visual representation of the relative performance of each model across the three categories.
